description: Heritage list-reporter alias profile gate (issue #669, slice H4): with the Heritage profile ACTIVE, the three list-reporter aliases `bf`/`bl`/`se` (spellings of the Core reporters `butfirst`/`butlast`/`sentence`, spec/commands.md's per-command Aliases rows) are all accepted silently (no diagnostics), including composed with one another (`bf bl :l`). Heritage is 'alternate spellings only' (spec/conformance.md#heritage) and depends on Core Language, Data and — since issue #860 — Turtle & Rendering (`PROFILE_DEPS.heritage = ["core-language", "data", "turtle-rendering"]`); `se`→`sentence` builds a list, so Data is the dependency these three aliases rest on, and the #860 edge is carried by the nine turtle aliases, not by these. Only `core-language`, `data`, and `heritage` are active here — the zero-diagnostic result proves these reporter spellings are made visible by the `heritage` profile alone. The sibling `heritage-list-reporter-aliases-rejected-in-core` shows the same program rejected without the profile.
